notes: TIER 1 (direct HTTP) succeeded fully; no block encountered, Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome not needed. robots.txt (https://www.indigo.ca/robots.txt) has no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow (it's a generic Shopify bot policy about checkout automation only), and the site publishes a dedicated /sitemap_agentic_discovery.xml plus Sitemap: directive, so full HTTP crawling is explicitly permitted. Method: (1) fetched homepage HTML and extracted all mega-menu data-menu-json blobs (Back to School, Books, Bestsellers, Kids' Books, Toys, Gifts, Stationery, Lifestyle/Home, Games & Hobbies, Sale) to find nav-exposed seasonal links -- found only 'The Halloween Shop' (Gifts menu), 'The Halloween Collection' (Lifestyle/Home menu), 'Kids' Halloween Books' (Kids' Books menu) and 'Kids' Halloween Gifts' (Toys menu) as currently-featured seasonal nav entries (site is Sept 2026, so Halloween is the in-season nav feature; Christmas/Easter/Valentine's/etc. are not currently billboarded in nav but their collection pages still exist and are indexed). (2) Fetched https://www.indigo.ca/a/sitemaps/sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (293 collection URLs) and grepped for every holiday keyword (christmas, halloween, valentine, easter, diwali, thanksgiving, new-year/lunar-new-year, hanukkah, jewish/christianity holidays, ramadan/eid, passover, mothers-day, fathers-day, kwanzaa, st-patrick). No Thanksgiving, Kwanzaa, or plain New Year's Eve/Day collection exists anywhere on the site (checked both keyword spellings) -- these holidays are genuinely absent from Indigo's taxonomy. (3) For every remaining candidate handle, queried the Shopify /collections/<handle>.json (collection metadata) AND fully paginated /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 (per Shopify products_count is unreliable) to get an exact, verified enumerated qty, and spot-checked product titles on first/middle/last pages of the larger collections (kids-christmas-books at 7500, halloween at 2462, christianity-holidays at 2147) to confirm thematic consistency (all confirmed genuinely on-theme, not polluted catch-alls). (4) Checked the French sitemap (https://www.indigo.ca/fr/a/sitemaps/sitemap_collections_1.xml, 293 URLs) -- it mirrors the exact same handles under /fr/, no French-exclusive holiday category exists, so English canonical URLs (www.indigo.ca, no /fr/ prefix) were used throughout. INCLUDED rows are real, currently product-bearing (qty>0), distinctly-URLed PLPs the site itself names after one specific holiday. EXCLUDED as currently-empty/not-yet-stocked (verified qty=0 via full products.json pagination, not just the unreliable count field): christmas (main '/collections/christmas-shop', titled 'Christmas'), christmas-decor, christmas-candles-lighting, christmas-cards, christmas-mugs, christmas-ornaments, christmas-pillows-throws, christmas-stockings-holders, christmas-tabletop-decor, christmas-tween-gifts, christmas-vinyl, christmas-gifts-0-2/3-5/6-8-year-olds, kids-christmas-collection, halloween-adult, halloween-gifts, halloween-shop, kids-halloween-kids-costumes-toys (qty 0), plus near-empty halloween-kids (1) and halloween-teen (2), mothers-day, fathers-day, mothers-day-boxed-cards, hanukkah-gifts-essentials, easter-shop, valentines-day-shop, kids-valentines-day-collection, valentines-day-boxed-cards. EXCLUDED as editorial/gift-guide/curated-picks pages per the marketing-page rule (name signals a staff pick list or 'best of' guide, not a genuine full category, and/or tiny hand-picked size): top-christmas-gifts (0 anyway), christmas-books-for-kids (10, a small featured subset of the 7500-item kids-christmas-books), christmas-stocking-stuffers (6, generic non-Christmas-specific gadgets), top-easter-gifts-for-kids (66), valentines-day-top-gifts (41), valentines-day-top-gifts-kids (5), sale-kids-teen-valentines-day-reads (92, 'sale'-prefixed clearance-style page), mothers-day-gift-guide (8), heathers-picks-mothers-day (38), heathers-picks-fathers-day (10). EXCLUDED as broad religious/social-studies book-genre subjects covering many different holidays rather than one named event (site classifies these as book subject taxonomy, not a single-holiday shop, despite containing seasonal-adjacent titles): jewish-holidays (380), christianity-holidays (2147, sample-checked: almost entirely Advent/Christmas devotional books, but the category's own name is a generic religion-subject label, not 'Christmas'), social-sciences-holidays (147). EXCLUDED as a redundant near-duplicate of a kept row with the same meaning under a second URL (kept the larger one): kids-fathers-day-books (55, 36% product overlap with the kept fathers-day-kids-books at 96) -- this is the one deliberate case of picking a single row for what is effectively the same taxonomy node reachable by two handles; every other pair with meaningful count/overlap difference (e.g. Lunar New Year Books 54 vs Kids' Lunar New Year 43 -- only 4.7% overlap, genuinely different product sets; Ramadan & Eid 83 vs Ramadan Books 17 -- 41% overlap but different scope, broad gift shop vs. book-only sub-genre) was kept as two distinct rows since they are not identical listings. CONFIRMED: every included row below has its own distinct handle/canonical URL -- no link is reused across two different sub_category names (checked programmatically against the full row list before writing this file), directly addressing the historical Indigo duplicate-link defect flagged for this company. Diwali, Lunar New Year, Ramadan & Eid, Passover, Mother's Day and Father's Day were treated as in-scope 'other genuine seasonal/holiday events' per the task's open-ended holiday definition, since Indigo's own taxonomy names them individually with real product listings.
